text: Given a valid name and no other parameters, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then it sends POST /flexible_asset_types with only attributes.name set and returns the created type's id and name.

Given name, enabled, description and icon are all passed, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then all four are forwarded as data.attributes; given description/icon are omitted on a separate call, Then they do not appear in the sent body at all.

Given a fields list with one entry (name, kind, order, show_in_list), When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then the upstream request carries data.relationships.flexible-asset-fields.data with exactly one item whose type and attribute keys match the design's casing decision (type flexible_asset_fields, kebab-case attributes).
notes: Casing is a design assumption (no live account to verify against, see Open questions); this test locks the assumption so a future correction is a deliberate, reviewed change, not a silent drift.

text: Given fields is omitted, and separately given fields=[], When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then the upstream request body has no relationships key at all.

Given a fields entry missing kind (and, separately, missing name), When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "invalid_argument", ...}} and no HTTP request is sent.
Given the X-ITGlue-API-Key header is missing, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "not_configured", ...}} rather than raising.
notes: Covered generically via the shared run() path (asserted today against get_organization); the new tool goes through the same run() helper unmodified, so no per-tool duplicate is required unless the dev leg wants an explicit assertion.

text: Given IT Glue returns 409 for a duplicate type name, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "invalid_argument", ...}}; given a field's default_value is a secret-looking string and the request errors, Then that value does not appear anywhere in the returned error message.

Given tools/list is queried, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_type is registered, Then it is present with readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint false, no agent_id parameter, is listed in README's Tools table, and no existing tool loses a name or parameter.
notes: Requires adding an itglue_create_flexible_asset_type entry to tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json, and one new readOnlyHint-false assertion in test_annotations, in the same change (done).

text: api.attributes() unit coverage: given relationships=None (default), the built document is byte-for-byte identical to today's output; given a relationships dict, the built document nests it under data.relationships as {key: {"data": items}}.
notes: Direct test of the one new, reusable piece of machinery (api.attributes()'s relationships parameter), not only indirect coverage through the tool test. Test file tests/test_api.py may not exist yet in the repo; dev leg creates it or adds to the closest existing api-level test module if one exists under a different name.
